The memory notes mention a deferred structural fix: hydrating #last-updated-badge from stats.json in app.js so badges never go stale.

That's a good candidate: a small, real improvement. It makes the site more coherent — the footer "Last updated" badge would always be current, and it would end the drift problem. It's small enough to land today.

Actually, let me reconsider. The body "Last updated" on each page is the time that page was last refreshed. The footer badge is a generic "last updated" for the site. If we make the footer badge dynamic from stats.json, it shows the last change across the site. That's coherent.
